item.description: Highlight-reel Habs have lost games they should have won, but they've been consistently tough against the toughest opposition in the NHL.

item.title: Canadian Tire fined $1.3 million for using misleading reference prices on 'discounted' items
item.description: An investigation by the Office de la protection du consommateur found that the company rarely, if ever, listed certain items at the "original" price.

item.title: Seven Quebecers to follow at the 2026 Winter Olympic Games in Milano Cortina
item.description: Two skiers, two speedskaters, a pairs figure skater, a snowboarder and the Montreal Victoire's Marie-Philip Poulin. Each of them is a force to be reckoned with and looking to bring home a medal.
